cohort: 3041 singletons and 1788 multiple children born from IVF/ICSI in the Netherlands between 2003-2005
finding: Perinatal outcomes in IVF/ICSI-conceived multiples are considerably poorer than in singletons, particularly in low-risk children; high-risk multiples had better perinatal outcomes than high-risk singletons.
mod_finding: High-risk multiples had a significantly better cesarean section rate than high-risk singletons.
